name: Prompt Remix Deck
description: Creative remix cards that help reshape story drafts with focused constraints.

cards.title: Genre Swap
cards.summary: Rewrite the selected section as if it belonged to a different genre.
instructions: Preserve the central character motivations and plot beats.
Adopt the tone, pacing, and tropes of the target genre.
Introduce one iconic detail that clearly signals the new genre.
constraints: Mention a sensory detail that reinforces the new genre.

cards.title: Time Period Flip
cards.summary: Move the scene into a different historical era or future timeline.
instructions: Translate technology, culture, and dialogue to the new era.
Highlight how the protagonist adapts (or fails to adapt).
Anchor the rewrite around one vivid historical or futuristic detail.
constraints: Open with a line that establishes the new time period.
Include at least one reference to the era's dominant technology.

cards.title: POV Change
cards.summary: Retell the moment from a different character's perspective.
instructions: Shift the internal monologue and emotional stakes to the new narrator.
Reveal information that the original POV could not see.
End with a line that hints at the narrator's next intention.
constraints: Use first-person narration for the new POV.
Limit the rewrite to two paragraphs.

cards.title: Raise the Stakes
cards.summary: Heighten tension by escalating what the protagonist stands to lose.
instructions: Clarify the immediate consequence if the protagonist fails.
Introduce a ticking-clock element or urgent deadline.
Show how another character reacts to the increased pressure.
constraints: Include a reference to time passing or running out.
Close with a sentence that leaves a question unanswered.

cards.title: Sensory Shift
cards.summary: Reimagine the scene by amplifying an unexpected sensory lens.
instructions: Choose one dominant sense (smell, sound, touch, taste, or sight).
Filter the narration so that sense drives imagery and emotion.
Connect the sense to a character memory or association.
constraints: Begin each paragraph with a sensory-focused sentence.
Use at least two metaphors tied to the selected sense.
